body:
A Beautiful Thing
My MXE experience was like nothing I've ever experienced my whole life other than my chronicles with DMT the summer of 2014. Dosing in the hundreds of times in the comfort of my home and in my travels in the Canadian festival scene. I've also reached plus 4 (++++) with several different batches of LSD reaching up to 16 doses on a given night. Usually Saturdays aka 'acid day' where my alter ego as the paper shredder comes out. True story lol.
Anyway, day one involves running-up, which is a process of searching for activity in a new drug by a strategy of taking incrementally larger and larger doses, at time intervals which are calculated to minimize the development tolerance. The increase is either 60% or 100% of the previous dose. Day one involves 2 doses at 200mg and smoking large amounts of cannabis all day long. However I didn't experience any hallucinations or out of body experience. Just fatigue and passed out around 1am. I did however experience a new and cosmic frequency and ringing in my ears like listening into deep space. Super addicted to that frequency in fact my favorite ALERT of MXE.
Day two involves three doses three hrs apart at 100mg, 125mg, and 150 mg and smoking cannabis all day long. The new frequency that I was operating on allowed me to manipulate energy within the room as my friends experienced a CONTACT HIGH which I find is a common occurrence in a group experiment with a psychedelic drug. Everyone was prone to this unintentional participation. It wasn't until the last spliff of the night that I experienced the first stages of my out of body experience. I put myself to bed as I was feeling extremely light headed and uncoordinated, high beats per minutes, floating like a feather.
As soon as the lights went off I heard a unique and voice-like transmission coming from outside my door. I got up and feeling pretty fucking amazing I stumbled over to the front door, opening it and was face to face with a little black cat calling me at a new frequency I have never heard before. It immediately ran away after a short stare down and ran underneath the neighbor's car. I could hear it calling out to me  inside my room, inside me house, for about 15 min in what sounded like cosmic radio waves. I turned off all the lights in the house and then blast off!! I was in the matrix.
I could see in the dark yo and everything around me slowly came together in matrix coding. It was very overwhelming at first but  like any psychedelic I have to come to terms that at this point there is no going back. As a lay back down I splashed into a sea of boiling blood followed by interstellar travel into a dark catacomb with shadowy figures slithering all over the walls. At this point I instantly created a pentagram or force field if you will around my body. Recommended by many shamans I have met in my travels. It may sound like hocus pocus but it worked and kept them at bay. Its is said that our bodies have several fractures of oozing energy at this transcending state and dark energies prey on it. In any case those things scared the crap out of me and it worked.
I was then surrounded by purple smoke that oozed through the cracks of the walls. In my head I wished it to be green and slowly it changed to green smoke. I never knew I could have this much control and was alternating between green and purple, colors which I could manipulate with my hands at will.
I never knew I could have this much control and was alternating between green and purple, colors which I could manipulate with my hands at will.
In swirls and spirals and what have you. What else could I conjure? I called out star glazed night and all of a sudden the whole ceiling turned into it. Pretty cool I have to say. I then turned my hands into a telescope and proceeded to travel though space without control and would end up in ancient caverns and trails and forests I've never been before. It would always lead my to corners but would never let me see what was on the other side. This went on for who knows how long but I remember being in the serengeti in sight of massive male lion and a white tiger. The tiger slowly creeped towards me and a called out to it and said chill out. We're in this together homie we are equals. To transported to a planet made of magma and steel. Several horses pierced out of the fire and road towards me with a single man on the horse closest to me.
Finally I traveled back to my room surrounded by purple ooze and muck that proceeded to fill the room at an alarming rate I couldn't breathe  had to leave my room. Ended up on a giant bean bag we have in the living room and gazed at the ceiling as a spidery web like blanket I could manipulate in any way.
At this point about 6 hrs had passed what seemed 10 minutes. I began to play with time and could slow down, rewind and fast forward into my dream. It was almost as if life was passing before my eyes in an uncontrollable spin and slowly began to taper off and back into my body. Thirsty as fuck and still drugged out to shit I had to crawl the the bathroom sink and drank about a gallon I swear. Covered in sweat. And then I passed out in a closet for about 6 hrs.
Anyway that's my experience and I will definitely be exploring future times at higher doses of course.
Spiritual use and not a party drug. Top 5 in my books.
